settings.aboutCreativeProcess:
1. Narrative Ingestion & Script Breakdown — Organizing raw footage, pulling select bites, and mapping emotional beats.
2. The Structural Assembly — Constructing the foundational spine before touching effects or music.
3. Pacing, Micro-Cuts & Retention Flow — Refining transitions, removing dead space, and accelerating audience engagement.
4. Immersive Soundscapes & Audio Mix — Multi-track foley, risers, hits, and mastered dialogue that make scenes hit harder.
5. Precision Color Grading & Final Polish — Distinct cinematic look creation, skin tone stabilization, and multi-platform master export.
